svg.title: GONE | Ship interior atlas, proposed thirty-deck network
svg.desc: Proposed out-of-world interior schematic with seven four-to-five-deck groups, five districts in each, four continuous vertical shafts, two local outboard bay scars with sealed neighbors, and a coordinate-accurate inset of the built stasis bay, corridor and same-deck secondary power room. Bow is left; exterior form is not depicted.
svg.text: Proposed D01–D30 network / NOT A HULL PLAN
longitudinal circulation → stern · four transverse lift / stair / service trunks
each band groups several physical decks
Thirty proposed decks. One built opening.
Each band compresses 4–5 decks into a district diagram. Repeated small cells stand for
additional rooms, not a fixed room count. Cross-aisles, ring paths and four trunks give
alternative routes; local scarred bays are sealed off, while the spine and trunks remain continuous.
OUT-OF-WORLD DESIGN REFERENCE · The player cannot infer the hull or damage from the opening.
The fictional terminal gains only a basic deck plan later; damaged areas and all routes beyond the opening remain proposals.

g.text: Local floor-plan meters (x, z). +x → stern; +z ↑. Rooms not to scale with atlas bands.
Power x 21..33 / z -9.7..-1.7 · no door past corridor endcap
Bright cyan marks the built opening only. All other districts are proposed, not walkable.
